a: A war banner, painted red. Nobody remembers what colour it was before. Somebody has added a handprint.
e: A bucket of water and a ladle. For afterwards, when everyone has gone back to their usual colour.
u: A war drum, painted in three stripes. Hit it and the whole hall goes red, for a moment.
d: A dummy for practising the Fury on. It's seen things.
1: The way out, to the drill yard.

objects.name: Fury-mistress Hagga
lines: DRUM! CHANT! GO RED! Feel it in your teeth!
Every Kaldari goes red before a fight. Since the wastes. Since before kings.

answer: The Fury. Drum till your blood's louder than your fear. Then fight.
My gran said in the wastes it kept you warm. Here it keeps you… loud.

questions.ask: Going red? Looks like a tantrum to me.
answer: * Hagga goes red. Redder than anybody has ever gone.
…See? That's the Fury. Now get out of my hall before I drum on you.

objects.name: Tolly the Pink
lines: Three years I've been coming. Everyone else roars themselves red. I go… a sort of pink. Like a nice ham.
Hagga says I'm the least furious man in the north. I think I'm just calm. Somebody has to be.

answer: The drums are nice. And everybody's so cross. Somebody ought to bring biscuits.
Between us, I don't think the old kingdom went red. My nan has a cup with an open hand on it. She hides it.

questions.ask: Pink? You'd lose a fight to a biscuit.
answer: …That was unkind, you know. I'm only pink. I'm not deaf.

objects.name: Drummer
lines: Again! From the top! There's no top. It's just BOOM.

questions.ask: Do you ever play anything else?
answer: …Once I played a quiet one. Hagga cried. Then she threw the drum at me. BOOM.
It was very good. Lost my job for a week. BOOM.

objects.name: Drummer
lines: BOOM. …Is Tolly pink again? He's pink again.

answer: He likes the drums. He's the only one who listens to them. Everyone else is screaming.
Pink's a start. I went pink once. Then red. Then I fell asleep.

questions.ask: You've been playing the same beat for years.
answer: BOOM. …That one was for you. A rude one.
